text.tspan: Kenner PD's Flock cameras in 2025: what Kenner searched for, and who searched them for immigration
​Top: officer-typed 'reason' on Kenner PD's own 38,037 searches, grouped into buckets (rules in the README); 44% gave a generic or vague reason.​
​Bottom: outside-agency searches through networks including Kenner's cameras that were immigration-related. Right column: most-typed raw 'reason' strings per row.​

text.tspan: Counted as an immigration search: the typed reason contains HSI, whole-word ICE or ERO, 'immigr…', 'deport…' or 'alien'.
Or the search was run by HSI / US Border Patrol themselves.
